answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils with capability tokens that expire after one epoch and are earned only by completing a verified job. A newcomer may wander into the meadow of open tasks, but each token is bound to work its holder finished, not to a name it invented. Tokens cannot be transferred or stockpiled, so a farm cannot mint a thousand identities in advance and let them drink the nectar of rewards later. Each clone must separately perform checked work before it can bid again, and its tokens rot if it idles. Attack cost therefore equals honest labor, repeated for every fake.
